result.topic_en: The page argues that the straight line has more points than there are rational numbers, so new numbers must be created to make the number domain as complete (continuous) as the line, and it rejects defining irrational numbers by measuring extensive magnitudes in favour of developing arithmetic out of itself.

items.english: The straight line is therefore infinitely more complete in point-individuals than the domain of rational numbers is in number-individuals.

items.english: It therefore becomes absolutely necessary to refine substantially the instrument that mathematicians constructed by creating the rational numbers, through a creation of new numbers such that the domain of numbers gains the same completeness (or continuity) as the straight line.

items.english: Instead, I demand that arithmetic should develop out of itself.
